definitions.explanation: The physical and mental strength to do things actively.

examples.japanese: {精力|せいりょく}を{注|そそ}ぐ。
{精力的|せいりょくてき}に{活動|かつどう}する。
{精力|せいりょく}が{衰|おとろ}える。

notes:
{精力|せいりょく} means energy, vigor, or vitality—the drive and stamina to pursue activities actively.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {精力的|せいりょくてき}に: energetically
- {精力|せいりょく}を{注|そそ}ぐ: to pour energy into
- {精力|せいりょく}を{傾|かたむ}ける: to devote energy to
- {精力|せいりょく}{旺盛|おうせい}: full of energy, vigorous
- {精力|せいりょく}が{衰|おとろ}える: one's energy declines

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {活力|かつりょく}: vitality (liveliness)
- {体力|たいりょく}: physical strength/stamina
- {気力|きりょく}: willpower, mental energy

NOTE:
{精力|せいりょく} can also refer to sexual vitality in some contexts.
